LanguageData.Gun_SCAR-H_STD_RWP.description: The SCAR-H STD is a robust and versatile firearm renowned for its accuracy and stopping power. Designed for adaptability on the battlefield, it uses hard-hitting 7.62mm NATO rounds and features a range of firing modes to handle various combat scenarios. Its durable construction ensures reliability in harsh conditions, making it a favored choice for those who demand performance and durability in their weaponry.
